nodes.text: Sit if you're sitting, buy if you're buying. The fire's free either way.
Shelf's honest, prices aren't kind. Carriage costs, this far out. Everything the road calls for, and a *brass key* for the locked chests out there.
Camps on the rises. Old ruins that _don't stay quiet after dusk_. And further out, stones that folk hang names on. The road pays better the further it runs. Fewer walk back to spend it.
You'll smell a camp before you see it: stumps, worn ruts, watchers on the high ground. Read the ground and you'll know what's waiting.
